name: More Nuggets
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: BlockLegend001
description: A simple mod that adds nuggets for all ores with recipes to obtain them.

softOff.why: registers blocks, items or entities (they stay, inert); data pack files (recipes, loot, tags) stay

works: Its nuggets are items of their own, and its recipes split an item into nine nuggets and put nine back together by hand (coal tried).
note: Not yet: the recipe book and /recipe don't list its recipes on Horizon Nightly 2026-11-04 (its recipe index skips a content mod's recipes; fixed upstream in 31756eb); crafting them in the grid or at a crafting table works.
